purpose: Gate 0 reference-baseline weights provenance (PRD section 6). Weights live OUTSIDE git in TEMPOCNN_WEIGHTS_DIR; this committed record pins their identity. The harness (tempocnn_baseline.py) refuses to run on a checksum mismatch.

model_variant.paper_name: The single-step tempo CNN of Schreiber and Mueller, ISMIR 2018 ('A Single-Step Approach to Musical Tempo Estimation Using a Convolutional Neural Network'), the network of Section 3.2 / Figure 2 (2,921,042 trainable parameters, 256 tempo classes covering integer BPM 30 to 285).
model_variant.why_this_variant: It is the variant whose GiantSteps figure is traced to primary text on BOTH annotation sets: Acc1 73.0 on the original Knees et al. 2015 annotations (2018 paper, Table 1b) and Acc1 82.5 on the revised crowd-sourced annotations (Schreiber and Mueller 2019, arXiv:1903.10839, Table 4a 'Literature' row, 661 tracks). Our ground truth derives from the revised annotations, so 82.5 is the aligned P input.
